data.name: Buraidah
data.gender_notes: Buraidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Buraidah is derived from the Arabic word 'Buraida', which means 'gardens of delight'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with Buraidah bint Al-Ash'ath, a noblewoman from the time of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was known for her generosity and hospitality to the early Muslim community. The name Buraidah carries the meaning “Gardens of delight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Buraidah usually hope their child will grow to embody gardens of delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes peace, tranquility, and beauty. It is a name for a girl who brings peace and harmony to her surroundings.
data.etymology: Buraidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardens of delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Buraidah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
